content.title: What are Bank Certificates and Statements?

blocks.content: These are official documents issued by your bank to prove your financial standing.

items: **Bank Certificate:** A one-page formal letter confirming you have an account, its current balance, and its opening date.
**Bank Statement:** A detailed list of all transactions (deposits, withdrawals) over a specific period (usually 3 or 6 months).

blocks.content:
These documents are commonly used for:
*   Tourist or Student Visa applications
*   Housing or Car Loan applications
*   Proving "Strong Ties" to the Philippines for travel
*   School enrollment or scholarship requirements

You may need these documents if you are:
- A traveler applying for a visa (Japan, Korea, Schengen, etc.)
- A borrower applying for a credit line or loan
- A student applying for a program that requires financial proof
- A business owner proving liquidity for a contract

content.title: Benefits of Having a Bank Certificate/Statement

blocks.content: These documents serve as credible evidence of your ability to fund your plans.

blocks.title: Visa Approval
blocks.content: For most embassies, a healthy **Average Daily Balance (ADB)** is a key factor in proving you are a legitimate traveler and not an intending immigrant.

blocks.title: Financial Credibility
blocks.content: Shows banks and institutions that you have a stable source of income and consistent saving habits.

blocks.title: Walk-In (Branch of Account)
blocks.content: Visit the branch where you opened your account for the fastest service. Most banks can issue certificates on the spot.

blocks.title: Online/Mobile Banking
blocks.content: Many banks (BPI, BDO, UnionBank) now allow you to request and download Bank Statements as PDFs. Some even offer digital Bank Certificates with a QR code for verification.
**Pro Tip:** Most ID applications now require **Online Pre-registration**. Always take a screenshot of your QR code or transaction slip before heading to the office.

blocks.title: Determine Your Requirement
blocks.content: Check the requirements of the embassy or institution. Do they need a one-page **Certificate** or a detailed **Statement** of the last 6 months?

blocks.title: Visit Your Bank
blocks.content: Go to your branch of account. It's best to go during mid-morning to avoid long lines.

blocks.title: Fill Out the Request Form
blocks.content: Request the "Bank Certificate" or "Bank Statement" form. Specify if you need the **ADB** and the **Account Type** (Savings/Current) included.

blocks.title: Pay the Fee
blocks.content: Pay the processing fee (usually deducted from your account or paid in cash).

blocks.title: Claim the Document
blocks.content: For certificates, you usually wait 15–30 minutes. For statements covering several years, you might be asked to return the next day. Ensure the document is **signed** and has the **bank's dry seal**.

Applicants may process their documents at:
- **Your Bank Branch:** (BDO, BPI, Metrobank, etc.)
- **Online Banking Portal:** (For digital statements)

Typical processing timelines include:
*   Bank Certificate: 15–30 Minutes (Same Day)
*   Bank Statement: 1 Hour to 1 Day
There is no tracking system for these requests as they are usually handled immediately at the branch.
If you are requesting via online banking, you can usually check the status of your request in the "Transaction History" or "Service Requests" section of your bank's mobile app.

Applicants may experience:
- **"Show Money" Suspicion:** Large, sudden deposits right before a visa application can look suspicious to embassy officers.
- **Digital Bank Acceptance:** Some embassies may not yet accept printed statements from digital-only banks without a physical stamp.

items: **Missing ADB:** Forgetting to ask for the Average Daily Balance when required for a visa.
**Incorrect Name:** Ensure the name on the certificate matches your passport exactly.

blocks.content: Always double-check that the document has the bank's official dry seal or stamp before leaving.

items: Request your documents via your bank's mobile app if they support it.
If you have a "preferred" or "gold" status with your bank, the fees are often waived and processing is faster.
Ask for multiple copies if you are applying for more than one visa.

blocks.content: For the most accurate and up-to-date information, we recommend contacting your bank branch directly or visiting their official website.

items: **Bank Branch:** Visit your branch of account for physical certificates and statements.
**Online Banking:** Check your bank's official mobile app or web portal for digital statements.

blocks.title: Does a Bank Certificate expire?
blocks.content: Embassies usually require certificates to be issued within **1 to 3 months** of your application date.

blocks.title: Can I get a certificate from a branch where I didn't open the account?
blocks.content: Most modern banks (BPI, BDO) allow "inter-branch" requests, but some smaller banks may still require you to go to your "home branch."
